audit_metadata.audit_type: static repository, code-path, configuration, and official-source audit
audit_metadata.limitation: GitHub connector access was available; no SSH or remote shell action was available in this conversation. GPU occupancy, server-local files, installed packages, and live jobs remain unverified.

ablations.E2: Dataset B, 6,345 MEGA-CDP pairs, class/source-balanced weights
ablations.E3: Dataset B, 6,345 MEGA-CDP pairs, natural sample weights

transfer_evaluations.NLI4CT: 5,500 official test statements; target labels must not be used for fitting or selection
transfer_evaluations.MedPIC: 467 official questions; only the pre-specified 93-question development set may be used for M4 calibration

frozen_protocol.historical_comparison_boundary: The existing 806-path controlled comparison (2,293 A/P pairs and 40 C/F pairs) is historical. It must not be relabelled as a new E1 result or substituted for the official 7,458-path MEGA evaluation.

repository_findings.finding: The ASTER-CR baseline code defaults to the older repair-v2 run directory.
evidence: experiments/aster_cr/common.py: ROOT defaults to /home/gcx/aster_cr_20261108
configs/aster_cr_training_default.json: E1 data and model artifacts use the 20261111 reports and server-only balanced_train.jsonl
repository_findings.required_action: Create a new, isolated E1 baseline run root and export E1-compatible fit/dev/test views, pairs, path cases, score caches, and manifests. Do not point the new run at old repair-v2 caches.

repository_findings.finding: The current comparator code mixes external methods, custom controls, and ASTER-internal variants.
evidence: experiments/aster_cr/comparators.py: closed_form, LEACE, ITI, SEA, CAD, reference_fusion, prompt-template variants, legacy_m3
experiments/aster_cr/baselines.py: LoReFT, LoFiT, LoRA, last_layer
repository_findings.required_action: Keep closed_form, legacy_m3, and last_layer out of the external-baseline table. Report them only as internal controls or ablations. Treat reference_fusion as a custom supervised score-fusion control, not as CC or BC.

repository_findings.finding: The current prompt-template selector is not a strong evidence-filtering prompt baseline.
evidence: experiments/aster_cr/comparators.py: format_prompt and best_template evaluate answer order/verbalizer/task-wording variants
repository_findings.required_action: Add a pre-specified evidence-focused prompt that retains the complete guideline and patient input. Select any prompt variant on development sources only. Describe current best_template as prompt/verbalizer-format selection.

repository_findings.finding: CAD is implemented as a contrastive score baseline, but its context definition must be stated precisely.
evidence: experiments/aster_cr/comparators.py: CAD = 3 * full - 2 * reference, corresponding to alpha=2
reference() preserves the patient text, current node, and current condition while removing the full guideline tree and definitions
repository_findings.required_action: Keep CAD under context-aware contrastive decoding, not generic calibration. Document the reference as a guideline-tree/definition ablation, count the extra forward, and re-evaluate under E1. Do not call the reference prompt context-free without qualification.

repository_findings.finding: Contextual Calibration and Batch Calibration are not implemented by the current reference_fusion code.
evidence: experiments/aster_cr/comparators.py: reference_fusion is LogisticRegression over full and reference scores, fitted with task labels
No CC or BC implementation was found in the tracked ASTER-CR code
repository_findings.required_action: Implement CC separately using its content-free calibration procedure. Treat BC as a transductive batch-level setting and report it separately from the per-instance inductive main comparison.

repository_findings.finding: LEACE and ITI are local task adaptations, not verified drop-in reproductions of the official implementations.
evidence: experiments/aster_closed_form/operators.py: local LEACE factors and pair-type/side concept coding
experiments/aster_cr/comparators.py: local ITI direction extraction from correct/incorrect answer completions and fit-source head ranking
repository_findings.required_action: Validate the local LEACE transform against EleutherAI/concept-erasure on synthetic and held-out representations. Document the exact concept coding. Document ITI as an E1 task adaptation and verify its head selection, direction, layer, and intervention strength against the paper.

repository_findings.finding: LoFiT in the local baseline code is an architecture-adapted implementation, not the official code path.
evidence: experiments/aster_cr/baselines.py: custom attention o_proj hooks, learned per-coordinate scaling and selected-head offsets, binary BCE training
fc2869/lo-fit README: official implementation customizes Llama-2 and Gemma-7B model classes and uses task-specific DPO/SFT trainers
repository_findings.required_action: Call the local result LoFiT-style/task-adapted unless an equivalence audit is completed. Compare its head-selection and offset stages with the official algorithm; record the changed task loss and model hooks.

repository_findings.finding: LoReFT depends on pyreft, but pyreft is absent from the tracked environment lock and requirements file.
evidence: experiments/aster_cr/baselines.py: from pyreft import LoreftIntervention
configs/environment.lock.txt: peft is pinned but pyreft is not listed
requirements-aster-manuscript.txt: only torch and transformers are declared
docs/ASTER/experiments.zh.md: historical LoReFT cache matched the original model
repository_findings.required_action: Install and pin pyreft in an isolated or explicitly extended environment, then prove non-zero intervention/logit change on a real Qwen3-8B checkpoint. A tiny random-model unit test is not sufficient.

repository_findings.finding: LoRA is implemented through PEFT, but current code targets one middle-layer q_proj and has no verified E1 real-checkpoint result in this audit.
evidence: experiments/aster_cr/baselines.py: target_modules is model.layers.{middle}.self_attn.q_proj
configs/environment.lock.txt: peft==0.21.2
experiments/aster_cr/test_models.py: tiny Qwen adapter gradient/cache-replay test exists
repository_findings.required_action: Retain the single-module setting only as an explicitly parameter-matched PEFT control, verify adapter activation and exact trainable parameter count on real Qwen3-8B, and compare with a pre-registered broader target-module setting only if the search budget permits.

repository_findings.finding: The baseline run seed and GPU defaults differ from the current experiment execution contract.
evidence: experiments/aster_cr/common.py: SEED=20261108 and default GPUS=0,1
docs/ASTER/experiments.zh.md: stochastic baselines are expected to use seeds 11,22,33
docs/ASTER/server-execution-task.zh.md: only physical GPUs 0,1,5,6 are permitted
repository_findings.required_action: Keep the frozen E1 data-selection seed unchanged. For stochastic external baselines, add explicit seed arguments and run 11,22,33. Set ASTER_CR_GPUS=0,1,5,6 only after checking server occupancy; never assume all four are free.

repository_findings.finding: The model revision is not immutably pinned in the tracked Qwen3-8B manifest.
evidence: configs/models.json: Qwen3-8B revision is master and file_revisions is empty
configs/qwen3_8b_modelscope_manifest.json: Revision and Sha256 fields are null
repository_findings.required_action: On the server, record the actual local model snapshot revision and tokenizer/config identity before any new run. Do not invent a revision or substitute a moving master reference.

repository_findings.finding: The minimal ASTER manuscript requirements omit optional baseline dependencies.
evidence: requirements-aster-manuscript.txt: torch and transformers only
configs/environment.lock.txt: includes PEFT, scikit-learn, numpy, torch, transformers; does not include pyreft
repository_findings.required_action: Maintain method-specific optional requirements or isolated environments. Do not upgrade the shared main environment to satisfy legacy or incompatible baseline repositories.

repository_findings.finding: SEA is referenced by the comparator code but is not CAST or CAA and its source is not tracked in the repository tree.
evidence: experiments/aster_cr/comparators.py: reads ROOT/vendor/sea/src/decoding_algorithm/inference.py
The current tracked Git tree contains no vendor/ directory
repository_findings.required_action: Keep SEA separately named and supplementary. Verify the server-side source and revision before use. Do not relabel SEA as CAST.

repository_findings.finding: configs/baselines.json is a registry for other TRIAGE workflows, not the ASTER-CR baseline registry.
evidence: configs/baselines.json: ProbeRAG, SEKA, JUICE, TrialGPT entries
repository_findings.required_action: Do not import these entries into the ASTER-CR main comparison without a separate task-equivalence justification.

repository_findings.finding: The name LEOPARD from earlier brainstorming was not verified against an authoritative paper and official implementation during this audit.
evidence: No authoritative LEOPARD concept-erasure paper/repository was established in the checked sources
repository_findings.required_action: Do not schedule LEOPARD as a baseline until its exact title, authors, venue, method, and official code are verified.

baseline_methods.representative_work: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
baseline_methods.protocol_note: Positive scalar scaling preserves the sign of a binary logit under a zero threshold. Report calibration metrics (Brier, log loss, ECE) and do not expect path accuracy to change solely from temperature scaling.

baseline_methods.representative_work: Calibrate Before Use: Improving Few-shot Performance of Language Models
baseline_methods.protocol_note: Implement content-free calibration with the same prompt/verbalizers; do not substitute the current supervised reference_fusion model.

baseline_methods.representative_work: Batch Calibration: Rethinking Calibration for In-Context Learning and Prompt Engineering
baseline_methods.protocol_note: Batch-level, transductive calibration; separate from the per-instance inductive main table unless the evaluation protocol explicitly permits unlabeled test-batch statistics.

baseline_methods.representative_work: Trusting Your Evidence: Hallucinate Less with Context-aware Decoding
baseline_methods.protocol_note: Current formula uses alpha=2 and two score paths. The reference keeps patient/current condition but removes the full guideline tree and definitions. Re-run under E1 and explicitly name this reference ablation.

baseline_methods.representative_work: Task-specific evidence-focused instruction baseline
baseline_methods.protocol_note: Existing best_template selects answer order/verbalizer/wording variants; it is not yet a dedicated instruction that asks the model to use decisive evidence and ignore irrelevant context while preserving all input.

baseline_methods.representative_work: Linear probing / supervised linear readout
baseline_methods.protocol_note: Current code contains ordinary/readout candidates. Verify the feature set and training split are E1-compatible before using the result.

baseline_methods.representative_work: LEACE: Perfect Linear Concept Erasure in Closed Form
baseline_methods.protocol_note: Local LEACE factors use pair-type/subtype and side coding. Validate against the official package; keep fixed original readout and re-trained readout as separate protocols.

baseline_methods.representative_work: Null It Out: Guarding Protected Attributes by Iterative Nullspace Projection
baseline_methods.protocol_note: Requires a precise nuisance-concept definition and repeated fit-only probes/projections. Report both fixed-readout and re-trained-readout variants.

baseline_methods.representative_work: Linear Adversarial Concept Erasure
baseline_methods.protocol_note: Requires a fit-only minimax projection and development selection of rank/optimization settings.

baseline_methods.representative_work: Robust Concept Erasure via Kernelized Rate-Distortion Maximization
baseline_methods.protocol_note: Official repository pins Python 3.6.13, PyTorch 1.13 and Transformers 4.12.5. Use an isolated environment or port the representation transform; do not downgrade the main environment.

baseline_methods.representative_work: Obliviator
baseline_methods.protocol_note: Current official package requires Python >=3.12 and PyTorch >=2.9; the tracked environment lock has PyTorch 2.8. Use a separate environment and validate the hidden-state interface.

baseline_methods.representative_work: Inference-Time Intervention: Eliciting Truthful Answers from a Language Model
baseline_methods.protocol_note: Local direction uses fit-only correct/incorrect answer representations and source-held-out head ranking. Verify equivalence to ITI and refit under E1.

baseline_methods.representative_work: Steering Llama 2 with Contrastive Activation Addition
baseline_methods.protocol_note: Official pipeline is Llama-2/data-task specific. A Qwen3 implementation using E1 pairs must be labelled CAA-style/task-adapted and retain its mean-difference steering objective.

baseline_methods.representative_work: Programming Refusal with Conditional Activation Steering
baseline_methods.protocol_note: Adapt the conditional gate to a pre-defined input-context trigger. Do not use test labels to decide whether an input should be steered.

baseline_methods.representative_work: RePS (Wu et al., 2025; AxBench implementation)
baseline_methods.protocol_note: AxBench contains RePS experiment configurations. First reproduce its original preference objective on a supported model; any E1 A/P/C/F adaptation must be named separately.

baseline_methods.representative_work: Steer Like the LLM: Activation Steering that Mimics Prompting
baseline_methods.protocol_note: Official code uses prompt-imitation training and position-specific coefficients; setup requires Python >=3.12, Hugging Face/OpenAI credentials and additional benchmark repositories. Build a task-specific prompt teacher and verify Qwen3 compatibility before scheduling GPU work.

baseline_methods.representative_work: LoFiT: Localized Fine-tuning on LLM Representations
baseline_methods.protocol_note: Local implementation is a Qwen3/Gemma3 hook port with binary BCE, not the official Llama2/Gemma7B task-specific DPO/SFT pipeline. Name it LoFiT-style/task-adapted unless equivalence is demonstrated.

baseline_methods.representative_work: ReFT: Representation Finetuning for Language Models (LoReFT)
baseline_methods.protocol_note: pyreft is not in the environment lock. The old cached result matched the original model. Require real Qwen3 adapter-load and logit-change tests.

baseline_methods.representative_work: ReFT-r1 (AxBench)
baseline_methods.protocol_note: Use as a recent AxBench representation-finetuning candidate only after model and objective compatibility is established.

baseline_methods.representative_work: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
baseline_methods.protocol_note: PEFT 0.21.2 is in the environment lock. Current adapter targets one middle-layer q_proj; validate activation, parameter count, and E1 data compatibility on the real checkpoint.

baseline_methods.representative_work: DoRA: Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation
baseline_methods.protocol_note: Supported by modern PEFT through use_dora; use the same target modules and parameter-matched budget as LoRA.

baseline_methods.representative_work: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning with Discrete Fourier Transform
baseline_methods.protocol_note: Official implementation is integrated into PEFT. It supports nn.Linear layers and not quantized layers; validate Qwen3 q_proj and parameter matching.

baseline_methods.representative_work: Full supervised fine-tuning control
baseline_methods.protocol_note: Optional high-cost upper-bound control. It changes all model weights and should be reported separately from parameter-efficient tuning.

Learned affine logit calibration; not Contextual Calibration or Batch Calibration.
Supervised logistic fusion of full and guideline-ablated reference scores; do not label CC or BC.
Separate SEA comparator; not CAA or CAST.
Exclude from the external-baseline table; place in internal ablation/history.
ASTER operator variant, not an independent external baseline.
Simple learned residual offset control; keep in ablation/control analysis, not as a literature baseline.

codex00_handoff.gpu_policy: Use only physical GPUs 0,1,5,6; set ASTER_CR_GPUS explicitly after server-side occupancy checks. No live occupancy result was obtained in this audit.
codex00_handoff.seeds: Use seeds 11,22,33 for stochastic external baseline runs as required by the experiment framework; preserve the already frozen E1 training seed.
codex00_handoff.test_policy: No test labels for training, tuning, threshold selection, rank selection, prompt selection, or method selection.
codex00_handoff.output_policy: Each method gets an isolated run ID and output directory. Preserve negative results and all failures. No published-paper scores may fill missing Qwen3-8B/E1 results.
